Get tableX

Source: R/AllGenerics.R
tableX.Rd

Get tableX

Usage

tableX(x, ...)

Arguments

x

input object

...

additional arguments

Value

tableX slot of x

Examples

x <- randomWeb(10)
tableX(x)
